about_the_game:
Are you ready to step into the raw and ruthless world of WASTED Bloodline, the new multiplayer video game that redefines the concept of pure adrenaline?

Developed with the incredible power of Unreal Engine 5.5, the most advanced graphics engine of the moment, the game offers an uncompromising experience and delivers a breathtaking visual spectacle where every detail, from the subtlest shadows to the conflict-ravaged landscapes, comes to life on screen.

WASTED Bloodline is a game that combines the best of competitive multiplayer and offline experiences, making it perfect for every type of player.

The game features multiple modes:

  • FREE FOR ALL

    A competitive multiplayer mode where you can challenge your friends or others from around the world in a no-rules battle where every player fights for themselves.

  • TACTICAL OPS

    Advance with your squad and capture strategic objectives in a fixed sequence.

    Coordinate every move, defend the captured positions, and blow up the enemy warehouse to secure victory.

    In this mode, tactics, teamwork, and timing are essential to dominate the battlefield.

  • NETWORK BREACH

    In this game mode, your team must hack critical points across the map to gain control of the territory.

    Each breached node brings your team closer to victory, while every lost point puts the entire operation at risk.

    Challenge your opponents in a race against time, the team that hacks the most points before the clock runs out will win the match.

  • TEAM DEATHMATCH

    Face off against the opposing team in a blood-soaked showdown where only one simple rule applies: The team that stays standing wins. 

  • GUN GAME

    Does your opponent have better weapons than you? Take them out and claim their gear. No prisoners are taken here, and every kill allows you to progress in your arsenal. 

  • ZOMBIE HORDES

    Is your world overrun by ferocious zombies hungry for fresh flesh? Form a squad, gather your courage, and take on the enemy hordes in a no-holds-barred battle. Every street, building, and corner hides danger, and every zombie defeated brings you closer to freedom.

 

What if I don’t have a good internet connection?

No problem.

With offline mode, you can test whether man or AI is stronger by facing the game's advanced bots. Beware, though: they're capable of replicating human player behavior.

Teams, solo, or special modes: Choose your playstyle!

Prepare your character, weapons, and gameplay approach to adapt to the battlefield and leave your mark in every match.

Use cover, plan your moves, and adapt quickly to every situation.

Each match is unique, and your survival depends on quick reflexes and smart strategies.

 

Are you ready to leave your mark?

But the surprises don’t end there…

The game maps are designed to offer a dynamic and unpredictable experience. Some will be set during the day, others at night, while others will feature a dynamic time cycle, where the time of day changes at the start of each match and progresses throughout, affecting visibility and atmosphere.

Additionally, the game will include a wide range of weather events that vary by level type. For instance, snowy regions might feature light snowfalls or full-blown blizzards; maps could have thunderstorms, lightning, torrential rains, thick fog that limits vision, or even sandstorms in desert environments.

These dynamic elements not only enhance immersion but will also force players to adapt their strategies to changing environmental conditions.

 

Why WASTED?

The game is set within the narrative universe of WASTED Will Be Brutal () and serves as a prequel.

In a world now desolate and marked by devastation, two factions clash in an endless conflict. The private militia of MEMENTO, a powerful and ruthless paramilitary organization, is determined to maintain control over what remains of the Earth, using any means necessary to subjugate anyone who dares to resist. Trained, equipped with cutting-edge technology, and ready for anything, MEMENTO soldiers are an unstoppable force spreading terror wherever they go.

On the other side are the SURVIVORS, a group of enhanced fighters forged through hardship who resist with all their might. These are men and women who, instead of succumbing to despair, have learned to survive with ingenuity and adaptability in an unforgiving world. They know the terrain like the back of their hands, and their strength lies in improvisation: Every resource can be used, every corner can become a trap, and every strategy is valid to survive and stop MEMENTO.

The conflict is fierce, the opposing forces are relentless, and the war for survival has just begun. Who will prevail in this lawless world, where the battle is not just for dominance but for the hope of a free future?

 

Both factions, MEMENTO and Survivors, feature a variety of distinctive classes, carefully balanced to ensure fair and engaging gameplay. Each class comes with dedicated weapons and equipment and unique movement speeds that reflect their battlefield roles.

The classes include roles such as:

  • Assaulters, experts in close combat capable of dealing significant damage with high-rate-of-fire weapons.

  • Armored Units, the backbone of the team, with high damage resistance and weapons designed for prolonged support.

  • Snipers, deadly from a distance, capable of eliminating key targets with surgical precision.

Each class not only contributes its combat style but also offers unique movement dynamics: Some classes are fast and light, perfect for hit-and-run tactics, while others are slower but incredibly resilient, ideal for strategic and defensive positioning.

The classes are currently in development and may evolve over time through future updates to ensure balance and a fresh gaming experience.

 

The game will launch in Early Access, giving players the chance to actively contribute to the project’s development. During this phase, Wasted Bloodline will gradually improve with the addition of new features such as maps, weapons, modes, and aesthetic customizations.

We will also introduce a global player leaderboard, featuring a ranking system that rewards skill and progress on the battlefield.

Climb the ranks and prove your worth among the best.

Every update will be based on community feedback, ensuring that the game evolves in line with player expectations and desires.

Initially, multiplayer will rely on peer-to-peer connections to provide a solid gameplay foundation, while the development team explores the possibility of implementing dedicated servers for even more stable performance and a better online experience.

The option to play offline with bot matches offers players a great opportunity to explore maps, try new strategies, and hone their skills before diving into online action. This feature adds an extra layer of accessibility, allowing the game to be enjoyed even without a stable internet connection.

 

A central aspect of the project is community involvement, which will be an integral part of development.

Through feedback collected via forums, surveys, and social media discussions, the team will work to optimize every aspect of the game, making it a unique and rewarding experience. Players’ contributions will be visible in every improvement and addition, strengthening the bond between developers and the fan base.

The 1.0 version of Wasted Bloodline is scheduled for release by the end of 2025.

After the official release, the game will continue to receive regular updates, including new content and features to keep the experience fresh and engaging over time.

Join our Discord!

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce RTX 2060 Super 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700 8GB / Intel ARC A770 16GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD

  • Processor: Intel i5-11600KF / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce RTX 3060Ti 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 6700XT 16GB / Intel ARC A780 16GB

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
